mainTopic: Does the משנה of אותו ואת בנו follow רבי שמעון, and why does it not mention lashes for מחוסר זמן?
overview: The גמרא tests whether the משנה of אותו ואת בנו follows רבי שמעון. רבי שמעון holds that a שחיטה which does not make the animal usable (שחיטה שאינה ראויה) is not counted as שחיטה. It goes through three cases: קדשים slaughtered outside, חולין slaughtered inside, and קדשים slaughtered inside. In each case, רבי שמעון's rule would mean the first slaughter does not count, so the משנה's ruling about the second animal makes no sense. The גמרא concludes that the משנה does not follow רבי שמעון. It then explains why this needed saying: the קדשים case was not obvious, because their שחיטה is a necessary step for the meat to become permitted. Next the גמרא asks why the second sacrificial animal does not also bring lashes for מחוסר זמן, an animal offered before its time. The first answer is that the משנה lists unrelated prohibitions only for an animal that has no אותו ואת בנו violation. רבי זירא then begins a different answer: set aside מחוסר זמן because of what the פסוק says, and his reasoning continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Sacrificial animals slaughtered outside: why no כרת for the second?
steps.stepSummary: Using רבי שמעון's rule, the first animal slaughtered outside was only 'killed.' So the second animal was still fit for the מקדש, and slaughtering it outside should bring כרת.
steps.simpleTranslation: The first animal was just killed, not slaughtered. So the second animal could still have been accepted inside the מקדש. Then the person should also be liable to כרת for slaughtering it outside.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the משנה's ruling about קדשים slaughtered outside the עזרה. It asks: according to רבי שמעון, why isn't the second slaughter punished with כרת?
steps.deeperAnalysis: Slaughtering קדשים outside brings כרת only if the animal was fit to be offered inside. The משנה treats the second animal as unfit, because its mother or offspring was already slaughtered that day. According to רבי שמעון, though, the first slaughter outside never counted as שחיטה, so nothing should block the second animal, and כרת should apply.

keyTerms.meaning: He merely killed it. It counts as killing, not as a halachic שחיטה.
Fit to be accepted inside the מקדש as a קרבן
Spiritual cutting-off. This is the punishment for slaughtering a fit קרבן outside the עזרה.

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think the second animal stopped being a קרבן. The question is only whether it was still fit to be brought inside, which is the condition for כרת.

phrases.english: The first one, he merely killed it;
phrases.notes: Slaughtering קדשים outside makes them unusable, so רבי שמעון doesn't count it as a real שחיטה.

phrases.english: the second is fit to be accepted inside;
let him also be liable to כרת.

steps.triggerLanguage: קַמָּא מִיקְטָל קַטְלֵיהּ, שֵׁנִי מִתְקַבֵּל בִּפְנִים הוּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the earlier test of whether the משנה fits רבי שמעון's rule.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that the second animal in the case of קדשים בחוץ brings only lashes and not כרת
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the first slaughter doesn't count, the second animal was never blocked and was fit to be offered inside. So slaughtering it outside should bring כרת.

steps.title: Quoting the case of non-sacred animals slaughtered inside
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the next case in the משנה: חולין slaughtered inside the עזרה. Both are unfit, and the second brings lashes.
steps.simpleTranslation: Non-sacred animals slaughtered inside: both are unfit, and for the second one he receives forty lashes.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the משנה's ruling about חולין slaughtered in the עזרה. It is setting up the same kind of question for this case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A חולין animal slaughtered in the עזרה becomes forbidden, so neither animal can be used. Still, the משנה says the second slaughter brings lashes for אותו ואת בנו, which means the first slaughter counted.

keyTerms.meaning: Non-sacred animals slaughtered inside the עזרה
Unfit or forbidden for use
He receives the forty lashes, which in practice means thirty-nine

phrases.english: Non-sacred animals slaughtered inside:
both of them are unfit,
and for the second, he receives the forty lashes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the next case in the משנה to test it against the same rule.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: When חולין are slaughtered inside, both animals are unfit, and the second slaughter brings lashes.

steps.title: Why lashes for the second non-sacred animal according to רבי שמעון?
steps.stepSummary: According to רבי שמעון, slaughtering a חולין animal inside does not count as שחיטה because the animal becomes forbidden. So the second slaughter should not bring lashes.
steps.simpleTranslation: We know that רבי שמעון says a שחיטה that doesn't make the animal usable is not called שחיטה. So the first animal was just killed. Why does he receive forty lashes for the second?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks how the משנה can give lashes for the second animal if we follow רבי שמעון.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The prohibition of אותו ואת בנו only applies if the first slaughter counts as a real שחיטה. For רבי שמעון, a חולין animal slaughtered in the עזרה becomes forbidden, so its slaughter doesn't count, and the second slaughter shouldn't be punished.

keyTerms.meaning: Since, after all. Introduces something we already know.
A slaughter that doesn't make the animal fit to use
It is not called a שחיטה
Why?

steps.whyThisMatters: רבי שמעון's rule is the key that unlocks all three questions in this section.

phrases.aramaic: מִכְּדֵי שָׁמְעִינַן לֵיהּ לְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן דְּאָמַר:
phrases.english: Since we have heard that רבי שמעון says:
a slaughter that is not fit
is not called a slaughter,
the first one, he merely killed it;
why does he receive the forty lashes for the second?

steps.triggerLanguage: מִכְּדֵי שָׁמְעִינַן לֵיהּ לְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן דְּאָמַר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the case just quoted to ask the same kind of question as step 1.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that the second animal in the case of חולין בפנים brings lashes
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The first slaughter made the animal forbidden, so for רבי שמעון it is not a שחיטה. Then nothing was 'slaughtered' first, and there is no אותו ואת בנו.

steps.title: Quoting the case of sacrificial animals slaughtered inside
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's case of קדשים slaughtered inside. The first is fit and he is exempt. The second brings lashes and is unfit.
steps.simpleTranslation: Sacrificial animals slaughtered inside: the first is fit and he is exempt. For the second he receives forty lashes, and it is unfit.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the third case of the משנה. It is setting up its final and strongest question.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here the first animal is a fully proper קרבן. Even so, the משנה treats its slaughter as counting, because the second animal is punished and becomes unfit.

keyTerms.meaning: Sacrificial animals slaughtered inside the עזרה, the proper place
Fit, and the slaughterer is exempt from punishment

phrases.english: Sacrificial animals slaughtered inside:
the first is fit and he is exempt,
and for the second he receives the forty lashes, and it is unfit.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the third case in the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: When קדשים are slaughtered inside, the first is fit and he is exempt. The second brings lashes and is unfit.

steps.title: Even proper sacrificial slaughter is 'unfit' according to רבי שמעון
steps.stepSummary: Even the slaughter of קדשים done properly does not permit the meat until the blood is thrown. So for רבי שמעון it is a שחיטה שאינה ראויה, and the second animal should not bring lashes or become unfit.
steps.simpleTranslation: We know that רבי שמעון says a שחיטה that doesn't make the animal usable is not called שחיטה. The slaughter of קדשים is also such a slaughter, because as long as the blood hasn't been thrown, the meat is not permitted. So why does he receive forty lashes for the second, and why is it unfit?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes רבי שמעון's rule even further. Even a perfectly proper קרבן slaughter doesn't count by itself, so the משנה's ruling here makes no sense according to רבי שמעון.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The שחיטה of a קרבן does not permit the meat on its own; זריקת הדם is still needed. By רבי שמעון's rule, that means the first slaughter isn't a 'שחיטה' yet. Then the second slaughter should be neither punished nor ruined.

keyTerms.meaning: Throws the blood on the מזבח. This step is what permits a קרבן's meat.
The meat is not yet permitted

steps.confusionAlert: The first animal here was slaughtered perfectly properly. The point is not that it was done wrong. It is that a קרבן's שחיטה alone doesn't yet permit the meat, so according to רבי שמעון it doesn't count.

phrases.aramaic: מִכְּדֵי שָׁמְעִינַן לֵיהּ לְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן דְּאָמַר:
phrases.english: Since we have heard that רבי שמעון says:

phrases.aramaic: שְׁחִיטָה שֶׁאֵינָהּ רְאוּיָה לֹא שְׁמָהּ שְׁחִיטָה,
phrases.english: a slaughter that is not fit is not called a slaughter,
the slaughter of sacrificial animals is also
a slaughter that is not fit,
since as long as he has not thrown the blood,
the meat is not permitted.

phrases.aramaic: שֵׁנִי אַמַּאי סוֹפֵג אֶת הָאַרְבָּעִים, וּפָסוּל?
phrases.english: Why does he receive the forty lashes for the second, and why is it unfit?

steps.triggerLanguage: שְׁחִיטַת קֳדָשִׁים נָמֵי שְׁחִיטָה שֶׁאֵינָהּ רְאוּיָה הִיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies the same question to the third case, and widens רבי שמעון's rule to cover even proper קרבן slaughter.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that the second animal in the case of קדשים בפנים brings lashes and is unfit
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A קרבן's meat is not permitted until the blood is thrown, so the first slaughter is 'unfit' and doesn't count. Then there is no אותו ואת בנו for the second.

steps.title: Conclusion: the משנה does not follow רבי שמעון
steps.stepSummary: Since all the cases clash with רבי שמעון's rule, the גמרא concludes that the משנה is not following רבי שמעון.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, learn from this that the משנה is not following רבי שמעון.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא wraps up: the משנה must be following a view other than רבי שמעון's.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The גמרא does not answer each question separately. It concludes that the משנה holds that even a slaughter which doesn't permit the animal still counts as שחיטה for אותו ואת בנו.

keyTerms.meaning: Learn from this. A formula used to state a conclusion.
Not in accordance with רבי שמעון

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה of אותו ואת בנו counts even a שחיטה שאינה ראויה as a real שחיטה. So it does not follow רבי שמעון, who holds such a slaughter is not called שחיטה.

phrases.english: Rather, learn from this
that it is not in accordance with רבי שמעון.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ דְּלָא כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws the conclusion from the questions on all three cases.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The משנה does not follow רבי שמעון's rule that a שחיטה שאינה ראויה is not called שחיטה.

steps.title: Isn't this obvious?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the conclusion was needed, since it seems obvious.
steps.simpleTranslation: Isn't it obvious that this is so?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why anyone had to say that the משנה is not following רבי שמעון, since that seems obvious. This question sets up the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The case of חולין slaughtered inside the עזרה clearly clashes with רבי שמעון, because the meat becomes forbidden. So why go through every case and state a conclusion at all? The גמרא wants to know what was not obvious.

keyTerms.meaning: It is obvious; why does this need to be said?
It is (so)

phrases.english: Isn't it obvious that this is so?
phrases.notes: "This" means the conclusion from Step 6, that the משנה is not following רבי שמעון.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions why the conclusion of Step 6 had to be stated at all.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What new point is gained by saying the משנה is not following רבי שמעון?

steps.title: The case of sacrificial animals needed to be said
steps.stepSummary: Saying it was needed because one might think the שחיטה of קדשים counts as a fit שחיטה for רבי שמעון.
steps.simpleTranslation: The case of slaughtering sacrificial animals needed to be said. You might have thought that slaughtering קדשים is a fit slaughter. If a person stabbed the animal and threw its blood, the meat would not become permitted. But if he slaughtered it, the meat does become permitted, so it is a fit slaughter. The conclusion teaches us that this is not so.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the חולין case is obvious, but the קדשים case is not. That is why the conclusion had to be stated.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With קדשים, a proper שחיטה is a needed step: if the animal was stabbed instead, even throwing the blood would not permit the meat. So you might call the שחיטה "fit" even though the meat is still forbidden until the blood is thrown. The conclusion teaches that, for רבי שמעון, this is still not a fit שחיטה, so the משנה really does clash with him.

keyTerms.meaning: It was needed for him; it had to be said
You might have thought (a mistaken first idea)
A fit slaughter, one that makes the meat permitted
Stabbed or tore the throat instead of slaughtering properly
This teaches us (the new point)

steps.confusionAlert: The point is not that the שחיטה of קדשים is bad. It is a needed step. It just does not count as a "fit" שחיטה by itself for רבי שמעון, because the meat still waits for the blood to be thrown.
steps.whatToRemember: The חולין case obviously clashes with רבי שמעון. The קדשים case needed to be stated, to teach that even a necessary שחיטה is not "fit" for him if it does not make the meat permitted by itself.

phrases.english: The slaughter of sacrificial animals was needed for him,
phrases.notes: "Him" is the one who said the משנה is not following רבי שמעון.

phrases.english: it might enter your mind to say:
the slaughter of sacrificial animals is a fit slaughter,
since if he stabbed it and threw the blood,
the meat is not permitted,
but when he slaughtered it, the meat is permitted,
so it is a fit slaughter;
so he teaches us that it is not.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers Step 7's question by showing what was not obvious.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The קדשים case was not obvious, because their שחיטה is necessary for the meat to become permitted. The conclusion teaches that it still does not count as a fit שחיטה for רבי שמעון.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Since the שחיטה of קדשים is needed for the meat to become permitted, it counts as a שחיטה ראויה.
steps.terutzMaskana: It does not count as a fit שחיטה for רבי שמעון, so the משנה is not following him.

steps.title: Why no lashes for an offering brought too early?
steps.stepSummary: The second sacrificial animal should also bring lashes for the לאו of מחוסר זמן.
steps.simpleTranslation: Let him also be lashed for the prohibition of offering an animal whose time has not yet come.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא goes back to the משנה's case of קדשים and asks why the משנה mentions only one set of lashes for the second animal. There should be another לאו too.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once one animal of the pair was slaughtered today, the other may not be offered until tomorrow, so offering it today means offering it before its time. Offering an animal that is מחוסר זמן is its own לאו. So the משנה should have mentioned lashes for that as well.

keyTerms.meaning: Let him be lashed
A negative commandment (a "do not")
Lacking time; an animal whose time to be offered has not yet come

phrases.aramaic: וְלִילְקֵי נָמֵי מִשּׁוּם לָאו דִּמְחוּסַּר זְמַן,
phrases.english: And let him also be lashed for the prohibition of an animal lacking time,
phrases.notes: Once the mother or its young was slaughtered today, the other can't be offered until tomorrow, so offering it today is too early.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְלִילְקֵי נָמֵי מִשּׁוּם לָאו דִּמְחוּסַּר זְמַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new question on the משנה's ruling about קדשים slaughtered inside.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that slaughtering the second sacrificial animal inside the עזרה brings lashes only for אותו ואת בנו.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The second animal is also מחוסר זמן, which is a separate לאו, so there should be lashes for that too.

steps.title: A ברייתא shows that offering a disqualified animal is a לאו
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא learns from a פסוק that offering any disqualified ox or sheep breaks the לאו of "לא ירצה".
steps.simpleTranslation: As a ברייתא teaches: How do we know that offering any disqualified ox or sheep breaks the prohibition of "it shall not be accepted"? The פסוק says: "An ox or a sheep with a limb too long or too short", and this teaches that offering any disqualified ox or sheep breaks "it shall not be accepted."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to support its question. The ברייתא shows that offering an animal that is unfit in any way is a real לאו.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק is already talking about oxen and sheep, so naming them again seems extra. The ברייתא learns from this that every kind of disqualification, including מחוסר זמן, falls under the לאו of "לא ירצה". This proves that lashes for מחוסר זמן are real, which makes Step 9's question stronger.

keyTerms.meaning: Disqualifications; things that make an animal unfit as an offering
"It shall not be accepted", the לאו against offering an unfit animal
The פסוק teaches
A limb too long, and a limb too short (fused hooves)

phrases.english: As it is taught in a ברייתא: From where do we know that all the disqualifications
of the ox and of the sheep
come under "it shall not be accepted"?
The verse says:
"An ox or a sheep with a limb too long or too short, etc."
This taught about the disqualifications of the ox and of the sheep,
that they come under "it shall not be accepted"!

steps.triggerLanguage: דְּתַנְיָא: מִנַּיִן לְכׇל הַפְּסוּלִין שֶׁבַּשּׁוֹר וְשֶׁבַּשֶּׂה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Backs up the question in Step 9 with a source.
steps.raayaObject: That offering an animal that is מחוסר זמן is a real לאו that brings lashes.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא learning from ויקרא 22:23 that all disqualifications of oxen and sheep fall under "לא ירצה".

steps.title: The משנה only lists the prohibitions of אותו ואת בנו
steps.stepSummary: There are lashes for מחוסר זמן too, but the משנה lists only prohibitions connected to אותו ואת בנו.
steps.simpleTranslation: When the משנה lists prohibitions, it lists those of "it and its offspring". It does not list outside, unrelated prohibitions.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that he really does get lashes for מחוסר זמן as well. The משנה just does not mention it, because that is not its topic.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה is teaching the laws of אותו ואת בנו, so it only counts lashes that come from that לאו. Other prohibitions that happen to apply in the same case are real, but they are "outside" the topic, so the משנה leaves them out.

keyTerms.meaning: Counts or lists
"It and its offspring", the ban on slaughtering a mother and its young on the same day
Outside or unrelated prohibitions

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה is not denying the lashes for מחוסר זמן. It only lists the לאווים that belong to its own topic, אותו ואת בנו.
steps.whyThisMatters: This teaches a general way of reading a משנה: when it counts lashes or prohibitions, it may be counting only those that belong to its subject, not every לאו that applies to the case.

phrases.aramaic: כִּי קָא חָשֵׁיב לָאוֵי דְּ״אוֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ״ –
phrases.english: When it lists prohibitions, it lists those of "it and its offspring";
phrases.notes: "It" is the משנה. The answer assumes he really is lashed for מחוסר זמן too.

phrases.english: outside prohibitions it does not list.

steps.triggerLanguage: כִּי קָא חָשֵׁיב לָאוֵי דְּ״אוֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ״
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits the scope of the משנה's list: the extra לאו is real but outside the topic.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The משנה's silence means there are no lashes for מחוסר זמן.
steps.terutzMaskana: There are lashes for מחוסר זמן, but the משנה only lists prohibitions related to אותו ואת בנו.

steps.title: Challenge: The משנה Does List an Unrelated Prohibition
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the claim that the משנה lists only prohibitions connected to אותו ואת בנו. It points to the case of קדשים בחוץ, where the משנה gives lashes that seem to come from an unrelated לאו.
steps.simpleTranslation: Does the משנה really never list unrelated prohibitions? In the case of קדשים slaughtered outside, which involves unrelated prohibitions, it lists them. It teaches: for קדשים slaughtered outside, the first animal brings כרת, and both animals bring forty lashes.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the answer from Step 11 by quoting the משנה's case of קדשים slaughtered outside the עזרה. This step sets up the challenge, and the next step explains exactly why this case is a problem.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 11 said the משנה lists only prohibitions tied to אותו ואת בנו. Here the גמרא brings a case where the משנה gives lashes for both animals, and it claims this includes a לאו that has nothing to do with אותו ואת בנו.

keyTerms.meaning: Sacrificial animals slaughtered outside the Temple courtyard
They receive the forty lashes

phrases.english: And does it not [list unrelated prohibitions]?
But there is the case of sacrificial animals slaughtered outside,
phrases.notes: Outside means outside the עזרה, the Temple courtyard.

phrases.english: which involve unrelated prohibitions,
and it lists them,
as it teaches: sacrificial animals slaughtered outside:
for the first one he is liable to כרת,
and for both of them he receives the forty lashes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the answer given in Step 11
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the משנה lists only prohibitions connected to אותו ואת בנו
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה's case of קדשים בחוץ seems to list lashes for an unrelated לאו, so the rule from Step 11 looks wrong.

steps.title: Why the First Animal Gets Lashes
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא sharpens the challenge. The second animal's lashes come from אותו ואת בנו, but the first animal's lashes must come from the unrelated לאו of שחוטי חוץ.
steps.simpleTranslation: It makes sense for the second animal, which brings lashes because of אותו ואת בנו. But why does he get lashes for the first animal? Isn't it because of the לאו of slaughtering קדשים outside?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא proves that the משנה's case really does include an unrelated prohibition. The first animal's lashes cannot come from אותו ואת בנו.
steps.deeperAnalysis: No אותו ואת בנו is broken when the first animal is slaughtered, because the problem only begins with the second one. So the lashes for the first animal must come from שחוטי חוץ, which is an unrelated לאו. This shows the משנה does sometimes list unrelated prohibitions.

keyTerms.meaning: It makes sense / granted (one side is fine, but the other is a problem)
The prohibition of slaughtering קדשים outside the עזרה

phrases.english: It makes sense regarding the second animal,
because of the prohibition of "itself and its offspring,"
but for the first one, why does he receive lashes?
Is it not because of the prohibition of slaughtering outside?

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא שֵׁנִי, מִשּׁוּם לָאו דְּאוֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ, אֶלָּא רִאשׁוֹן אַמַּאי סוֹפֵג
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains and strengthens the challenge of Step 12
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The first animal has no אותו ואת בנו violation, so its lashes must come from שחוטי חוץ, an unrelated לאו that the משנה does list.

steps.title: Unrelated Prohibitions Are Listed Only Where There Is No אותו ואת בנו
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא makes the rule more precise. The משנה lists an unrelated לאו only for an animal that has no אותו ואת בנו violation. Where there is such a violation, it mentions only אותו ואת בנו.
steps.simpleTranslation: Wherever there is no לאו of אותו ואת בנו, the משנה lists unrelated prohibitions. Wherever there is a לאו of אותו ואת בנו, it does not list unrelated prohibitions.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge by making the rule from Step 11 more precise.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first animal in קדשים בחוץ has no אותו ואת בנו problem, so the משנה mentions its שחוטי חוץ lashes. The second animal inside the עזרה does have an אותו ואת בנו problem, so the משנה does not bother to add the extra לאו of מחוסר זמן.

keyTerms.meaning: Wherever
There is / there is not

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה lists an unrelated לאו only for an animal that has no אותו ואת בנו violation. That is why שחוטי חוץ is listed for the first animal, but מחוסר זמן is not listed for the second.

phrases.english: Wherever there is no
prohibition of "itself and its offspring",
it lists unrelated prohibitions,
and wherever there is
a prohibition of "itself and its offspring",
it does not list unrelated prohibitions.

steps.triggerLanguage: כֹּל הֵיכָא דְּלֵיכָּא לָאו דְּאוֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The משנה never lists unrelated prohibitions, so listing שחוטי חוץ is a contradiction.
steps.terutzMaskana: The משנה lists unrelated prohibitions only for an animal that has no אותו ואת בנו violation.

steps.title: רבי זירא Begins a Different Answer About מחוסר זמן
steps.stepSummary: רבי זירא starts a new answer for why the משנה does not mention lashes for מחוסר זמן. He says to set it aside because of what the פסוק says.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי זירא said: Leave aside the prohibition of מחוסר זמן, because the פסוק...
steps.whatsHappening: רבי זירא opens another way to answer the question from Step 9 about the missing lashes for מחוסר זמן. His full reason continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 11 and Step 14 accepted that he is lashed for מחוסר זמן and explained why the משנה leaves it out. רבי זירא takes a different path. 'Set aside' signals that מחוסר זמן may not bring lashes here at all, because of how the פסוק treats it. His full reason continues on the next amud.

keyTerms.meaning: Leave aside / set aside
The פסוק (verse)

phrases.english: Rabbi Zeira said:
Leave aside [the prohibition of] an animal whose time has not come,
because the verse...

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי זֵירָא אָמַר: הַנַּח לִמְחוּסַּר זְמַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins a second, different answer to the challenge of Step 9
steps.terutzHavaAmina: מחוסר זמן should bring lashes, and the משנה should mention them.
steps.terutzMaskana: מחוסר זמן is set aside because of how the פסוק describes it (the explanation continues).
